title: test(plugin-security): warm the sqlite-wasm module once before the insert-check cells
body:
Fixes #37494
Refs #37636
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改了一份安全插件的自动化测试，产品行为前后不变。
- 为什么做：浏览器端数据库那一组用例在繁忙的持续集成机器上首次启动超时，已把主干的定时全量运行染红，也让无关的合并请求要手动重跑。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这组用例照旧偶发超时，不影响任何用户，直接撤回这一个提交即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts` only. A file-level `beforeAll`, with its own explicit 60 s hook budget, connects and closes one `SqliteWasmDriver({ filename: ':memory:' })` before any case runs. `loadSqlJs` caches the sql.js load and WASM compile per module instance (`packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm/src/wasm-connection.ts`, `cachedSqlJs`), so the driver-sqlite-wasm arm's first case no longer pays that one-time cold boot inside vitest's 5000 ms per-test budget, which is what ran to 5021 ms on a saturated shard (#37636).

- Global `testTimeout` / `hookTimeout` untouched; no assertion changed; nothing skipped, retried or quarantined.
- The warm-up driver is its own `:memory:` database, closed before the cells start, so no case shares state with it.
- The cold boot lives in the driver's module-level cache, not in a shared test helper; nothing outside this file changes.

## Tests

Local, shared box (absolutes are shared-box readings; the ratio is the portable number). Same file, same command, before vs after at `3c37d38b`:

| | first wasm case | second wasm case | ratio first/second | warm hook |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before (origin/main `6d106a1a`) | 178 ms | 67 ms | 2.66 | none |
| after | 74 ms | 72 ms | 1.03 | 63.7 ms (instrumented run, instrumentation not committed) |

<details><summary>File and package runs</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts` (plugin-security, under the verify lock): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 25 passed (25), VERDICT command-exit 0, before and after.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` (includes `check:test-typecheck` over the test layer): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` in plugin-security: Test Files 290 passed (290), Tests 7313 passed, 45 skipped (7358), VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No ablation: the diff changes test timing, not a behaviour a test pins; the before row above is the measurement without the hook.
- Test-only change; nothing in the package `files[]` (`dist` from `src/index.ts`) moves, so `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

Read first: the new `beforeAll` block above `afterEach` in the test file (the only hunk).

Two-minute check: `cd packages/plugins/plugin-security && pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=verbose src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts` — expect 25 passed, and the first `insert on driver-sqlite-wasm` case within a few ms of its neighbours rather than about 2.5x them.

54 derived, 51 run with exit 0, 3 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met locally: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs a commit absent from this shallow checkout; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` need the full workspace build). `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: 54 accounted for, 0 unrun. CI runs the farm.

</details>
